options.name: config_file
options.description: Path to the kopia configuration file describing the connection. Defaults to kopia's own configuration path when unset.

options.name: target
options.description: Policy target, a directory path, C(user@host), C(user@host:/path), or V((global)) for the global policy. When set, RV(policy) and RV(effective_policy) are returned for the single target instead of RV(policies).
